start: dev quicktest colony, minimal list plus GSS, all DLC (asserted)
a cleared 20x12 rect, GSS master on (asserted)
a powered run with battery, generator and two consumers per look, plus a WaterproofConduit run on shallow water (def asserted)
scenes.action: capture at play zoom with the power overlay off and on; lay a vanilla HiddenConduit run beside it
scenes.expect: no pipe drawn on any PowerConduit or WaterproofConduit cell, a cord per edge on both runs, overlay connector lines present; the HiddenConduit run owns no cord

control.case: the same run with the GSS master switch off
control.expect: the vanilla conduit pipe draws on every cell
control.rules_out: a room that reads clean because neither pipe nor cord is drawn

scenes.restore: restore terrain, walls, conduit, masts and things on the scene rect from the snapshot recorded at scene-begin; put power, factions, goodwill and every poked setting back to its prior value
